services_heading: Complete Central Heating Services Across Preston
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to full system installations, we handle every aspect of your heating.

services.title: Emergency Boiler Repair
services.desc: Boiler broken down? We attend most emergencies within two hours, diagnose the fault on-site, and carry common parts on the van to get you warm again fast.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Upgrade
services.desc: New A-rated condensing boiler fitted and commissioned, with full certification. Cuts your heating bills by up to 35% and comes with a 10-year parts guarantee.

services.title: Central Heating System Maintenance
services.desc: Annual servicing keeps your system running safely and efficiently. We flush radiators, check all connections, and replace worn components before they fail.

services.title: Radiator Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Leaking radiators, cold spots, or noisy pipes? We replace faulty radiators, balance your system, and cure circulation problems that leave rooms cold.

services.title: System Powerflushing
services.desc: Remove sludge and corrosion from your heating pipework to restore efficiency and stop radiators running cold. Extends boiler life by years.

services.title: Landlord Gas Safety Certificates
services.desc: Annual Gas Safety checks for buy-to-let properties in Preston and surrounding areas. Full compliance certificate issued same day.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I hated paying cowboys premium prices for poor work.
about_para_1: Dave Hewitson founded this business in 2008 after years working for larger heating firms and seeing customers overcharged for simple repairs. Based in Penwortham, we've built a reputation for honest advice, fair pricing, and heating systems that work. We're Gas Safe Registered and carry our full toolkit on every job — no call-out charge, no surprise invoices.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we show up on time, explain what's wrong without the jargon, and fix it right first time. We've earned over 250 five-star reviews by treating every Preston home like it's our own. Whether you need an emergency repair at midnight or a new boiler installed, you get the same personal service.
reviews_heading: What Preston Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with our boiler – packed in on the coldest day of the year. Dave was round within 90 minutes, diagnosed a faulty pump, and had us back on heat by evening. Charged a fair price, no mess, and he even showed me how to bleed the radiators. Can't ask for more than that.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Needed a new boiler and was dreading the cost. Dave gave an honest quote, explained why the old one couldn't be repaired, and fitted a Worcester condensing unit that's already cut my bills. The whole job took a day and his lad was really tidy. Proper job.
reviews.author: Sandra K.

reviews.text: Annual service on our heating. Dave walked me through everything he was checking, told me the radiator in the lounge needed balancing, sorted it there and then, and didn't try to sell me anything I didn't need. That's rare. Will book him again next year.
reviews.author: Peter G.
